verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents exports, monitoring and unmonitoring of customers, audit trails, and a 5-second TTL on export download URLs. None of these is a user-controllable data-retention policy or a customer or record deletion capability. Unmonitoring and download-link expiry are adjacent controls, not retention or deletion controls, so the applicable axis has no evidence of delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
